title: SmokePing Latency Weekly Median Latency Trend
dataSources: UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), AdGuard Home (`adguard:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`), router/firewall syslog, ISP uptime probes.
app: UniFi / router syslog, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and scheduled speedtests via HEC scripted inputs and the Universal Forwarder.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=smokeping:latency median_ms=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(median_ms) as avg_duration, max(median_ms) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst median latency for SmokePing latency events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture median_ms on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average median latency with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It rates whether SmokePing latency tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
